Equip your combat equipment, food, and light the Brazier in the west of Lunar Isle's town. The upcoming fight is hard, and you can only leave via the lecturn in the arena and cannot pray. Magic attacks are extremely effective for the fight.

steps.text: Take the marked items out of the bank.

notes: To handle the food you could use Sack of Potatoes(10), Sack of Cabbages(10) and Sack of Onions(10). This would allow you to carry all the food in just three inventory spaces. You will need to fight all 4 bosses in a row without prayers. It's recommended that you use magic as they all have very low magic defence.
rewards: 15,000 Experience Lamp (Combat, No Prayer or Attack)
Ability to bank without the Seal of Passage by talking to 'Birds-Eye-Jack'
